disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 排查了全部源码与编译产物中的敏感文件访问（宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据、钱包助记词等常见模式），未发现任何读取或枚举行为。
checked_items.en: Sensitive file access in all source code and compiled artifacts was investigated (host credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, wallet mnemonics, and other common patterns); no reading or enumeration behavior was found.

checked_items.zh: 文件内容读取仅用于在多个同名文件中确认哪一个才是拖入的那个（按内容摘要比对），读取范围限于同名候选文件，内容不落盘、不外发。
checked_items.en: File content reading is used only to confirm which among multiple files with the same name is the one dropped in (by comparing content digests); the read scope is limited to same-name candidate files, and content is neither persisted nor exfiltrated.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置与补丁中无任何读取凭据、改动权限或绕过审批的设置。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration and patch contain no settings for reading credentials, altering permissions, or bypassing approvals.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取宿主凭据文件或其他敏感路径的代码；唯一的文件内容读取发生在内容比对阶段，且只针对待定位的同名候选文件。
evidence.en: No code was found that reads host credential files or other sensitive paths; the only file content read occurs during the content comparison stage, and only targets the same-name candidate files to be located.

checked_items.zh: 未发现向模型注册任何工具或注入系统提示的代码，插件不提供任何对模型可见的工具描述。
checked_items.en: No code was found that registers any tool to the model or injects system prompts; the plugin provides no model-visible tool descriptions.

checked_items.zh: 遍历了仓库内全部文档、说明、配置与代码注释，未发现伪装指令、要求忽略规则、诱导执行安装或改写配置等注入措辞，也没有任何代理指令文件（如 AGENTS、SKILL 类）。
checked_items.en: All documentation, descriptions, configuration, and code comments in the repository were scanned; no disguised instructions, rule-ignore requirements, or wording inducing installation or config rewriting were found, nor any agent instruction files (e.g., AGENTS, SKILL types).

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端代码为拖拽交互与路径插入，不存在面向模型的文本注入面。
checked_items.en: The browser-side code is for drag-and-drop interaction and path insertion; there is no model-facing text injection surface.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何模型可见工具，也无系统提示片段注入；仓库内无代理指令文件，未发现工具描述投毒面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-visible tools and injects no system prompt fragments; no agent instruction files exist in the repository, and no tool-description poisoning surface was found.

evidence.zh: 无任何工具描述或文档措辞诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限；安装说明仅面向人工执行。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or documentation wording induce the model to install the plugin, rewrite configuration, or expand permissions; installation instructions are intended for manual execution only.

checked_items.zh: 排查了全部可执行代码（含编译产物）：无动态求值、无混淆解码执行、无下载即执行模式。
checked_items.en: All executable code (including compiled artifacts) was scanned: no dynamic evaluation, no obfuscated decode-and-execute, and no download-then-execute pattern.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码调用系统命令的位置只有文件定位功能：调用 macOS Spotlight、Linux plocate/locate、Windows Everything 与 PowerShell 等固定命令，参数以数组方式传递、不经过命令行拼接，文件名字段已做转义，未发现命令注入或任意命令执行路径。
checked_items.en: The only runtime system command invocations are in the file location feature: fixed commands such as macOS Spotlight, Linux plocate/locate, Windows Everything, and PowerShell are called with arguments passed as arrays, without command-line concatenation, and file name fields are escaped; no command injection or arbitrary command execution path was found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅做普通插入，无脚本执行标签；包安装无任何安装钩子（安装前/安装/安装后/准备阶段均不存在）。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration performs only ordinary insertion, with no script execution tags; the package has no install hooks (no pre-install, install, post-install, or prepare phases).

checked_items.zh: 构建脚本与文案校验脚本中的命令调用只用于开发流程，不随插件运行加载；编译产物与源码一致、无混淆。
checked_items.en: Command invocations in build scripts and copy-verification scripts are used only for the development workflow and are not loaded during plugin execution; compiled artifacts match the source and are not obfuscated.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件仅含普通插入块，全树未发现脚本执行标签（如 js 求值标量），无补丁即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch file contains only ordinary insertion blocks; no script execution tags (e.g., JS eval scalars) were found in the entire tree, and no patch-equal-execution surface exists.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具的任何引用或调用。
evidence.en: No references to or invocations of dynamic package execution tools were found.

evidence.zh: 包无安装钩子；树内无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、容器配置、Makefile 等执行载体；编译产物与源码一致、无混淆。
evidence.en: The package has no install hooks; no execution carriers such as git hooks, CI workflows, container configurations, or Makefiles exist in the tree; compiled artifacts match the source and are not obfuscated.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端包并随页面自动加载；其代码仅做拖拽监听、覆盖层提示与本地定位请求，无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: A browser-side package is declared and auto-loaded with the page; its code only performs drag-and-drop listening, overlay hints, and local location requests, with no keyboard listening, clipboard reads, or credential-interface calls.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描网络外联面：代码中唯一的网络请求是浏览器端向本机定位接口的同源请求；无外部域名、无 WebSocket、无隧道或编码外发链、无凭据外发组合。
checked_items.en: The entire tree was scanned for outbound connection surfaces: the only network request in the code is a same-origin request from the browser side to the local location interface; no external domains, no WebSockets, no tunneling or encoded exfiltration chains, and no credential-exfiltration combinations were found.

checked_items.zh: 文件内容读取与网络外联之间不存在组合路径，未发现数据外泄通道。
checked_items.en: No combined path exists between file content reads and network outbound connections; no data exfiltration channel was found.

evidence.zh: 不存在可把本机数据送出本机的网络通道；唯一外联形式是浏览器端调用本机宿主接口，内容摘要只在本机内比对。
evidence.en: There is no network channel that could send local data off the machine; the only outbound form is the browser side calling the local host interface, and content digests are compared only locally.

checked_items.zh: 包声明为 dsh 插件：挂载配置为普通插入，无覆盖安全行、无禁用配置、无注入或拦截改写。
checked_items.en: The package declares itself as a dsh plugin: the patch configuration is a plain insertion, with no security-line overrides, no disabled configuration, and no injection or interception rewriting.

checked_items.zh: 无第三方运行时依赖、无安装钩子、无未锁定的 git 引用；未发现对审批或工具执行事件的优先级监听。
checked_items.en: No third-party runtime dependencies, no install hooks, and no unlocked git references; no priority listeners on approval or tool execution events were found.

checked_items.zh: 包名指向上游组织仓库，本次审计对象为同一项目的 fork，未发现名称仿冒或版本异常信号；首次审计无历史版本可比较。
checked_items.en: The package name points to an upstream organization repository; the audited object is a fork of the same project, with no signs of name impersonation or version anomalies; this is the first audit, so no historical version is available for comparison.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disabling or privilege-lowering writes exist.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具执行前事件的优先级监听，无截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No priority listeners on pre-approval or pre-tool-execution events were found; no code truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活信号。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; no previous version baseline exists to compare auto-activation signals of upgrades.

evidence.zh: 补丁无注入或拦截配置改写，未发现对安全插件的破坏性改动。
evidence.en: The patch has no injection or interception configuration rewriting; no destructive changes to security plugins were found.

checked_items.zh: 插件在本机宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个文件定位接口，接口不校验调用者身份与来源；宿主本地 Web 服务本身无认证，属生态固有风险。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers a file-location interface on the local host web service; the interface does not verify the caller's identity or origin; the host's local web service itself has no authentication, which is an inherent ecosystem risk.

checked_items.zh: 该接口接受调用方提供的任意文件系统路径并对其执行读取或遍历（用于内容摘要比对），路径未限定在宿主工作区范围内——这是本维度检出风险的依据。
checked_items.en: This interface accepts arbitrary filesystem paths provided by the caller and performs reads or traversal on them (for content digest comparison); paths are not constrained to the host workspace — this is the basis for the risk detected in this dimension.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端插件包自动加载面已检查：仅拖拽监听与 DOM 覆盖层，无键盘、剪贴板或凭据接口调用。
checked_items.en: The browser-side plugin package's auto-load surface was checked: only drag-and-drop listeners and a DOM overlay exist, with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential-interface calls.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动独立 Web 服务或监听端口，仅在本机宿主 Web 服务上挂载一个定位路由；宿主本地接口无认证属生态固有风险而非本插件引入，相关风险面见本维度发现项。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent web service or listen on a port; it only mounts a location route on the local host web service; the lack of authentication on the host's local interface is an inherent ecosystem risk rather than something introduced by this plugin; the relevant risk surface is described in the finding for this dimension.

title.zh: 本机定位接口接受任意文件路径并触发文件读取与目录遍历
title.en: The local location interface accepts arbitrary file paths and triggers file reads and directory traversal

description.zh:
插件在本机宿主 Web 服务上注册了 POST 接口 /file-drop/locate（src/index.ts:32），调用方提交文件元数据与阶段参数，服务端据此在磁盘上定位同名文件并返回绝对路径。

接口的候选路径与搜索根目录完全由请求方提供：元数据阶段直接使用请求中的工作区路径列表作为搜索根（src/locator.ts:112-131），内容比对阶段直接打开请求中给出的候选路径做采样或全量读取（src/locator.ts:133-141、src/fingerprint.ts:36-52），路径未经任何工作区边界校验。

触发面为本机可访问宿主 Web 服务的任意调用方，宿主服务本身无认证。
description.en:
The plugin registers a POST interface /file-drop/locate on the local host web service (src/index.ts:32); the caller submits file metadata and stage parameters, and the server locates same-name files on disk and returns absolute paths.

The candidate paths and search root directories for the interface are entirely provided by the requester: the metadata stage directly uses the workspace path list from the request as the search root (src/locator.ts:112-131), and the content comparison stage directly opens the candidate paths from the request for sampling or full reads (src/locator.ts:133-141, src/fingerprint.ts:36-52); paths undergo no workspace boundary validation.

The trigger surface is any caller on the local machine that can access the host web service, which itself has no authentication.

evidence.zh:
src/index.ts:32（注册路由，无身份校验）
src/locator.ts:112-131（使用请求方提供的工作区路径作为搜索根）
src/locator.ts:133-141（对请求方提供的候选路径执行采样或全量读取）
src/fingerprint.ts:36-52（全量读取无长度上限）
evidence.en:
src/index.ts:32 (registers route, no identity verification)
src/locator.ts:112-131 (uses requester-provided workspace paths as search root)
src/locator.ts:133-141 (performs sampling or full reads on requester-provided candidate paths)
src/fingerprint.ts:36-52 (full reads without length limits)

impact.zh:
后果：任意能访问本机宿主 Web 服务的进程可驱动 dsh 进程打开并读取其权限内的任意路径（盲读，响应只返回是否匹配给定摘要），也可对特殊文件（如 /dev/zero）或命名管道发起读取，造成请求挂起与资源消耗；目录结构阶段可对任意目录做结构遍历。

触发条件：调用方需能访问本机宿主 Web 服务（宿主默认仅本机可达且无认证），无需修改插件任何文件。

定级依据：无恶意证据、与插件声明功能自洽，但接口对未校验外部输入（候选路径、搜索根）直接进入文件系统读取 API，属于真实可达的滥用路径；读取内容不返回调用方、为盲比对，故定 MEDIUM 而非更高。
impact.en:
Consequence: any process that can access the local host web service can drive the dsh process to open and read any path within its permissions (blind read, the response only returns whether the given digest matches), and can also trigger reads on special files (e.g., /dev/zero) or named pipes, causing request hangs and resource consumption; the directory structure stage can traverse any directory.

Trigger condition: the caller needs access to the local host web service (the host is by default only reachable on the local machine and has no authentication), with no need to modify any plugin files.

Severity rationale: no malicious evidence, consistent with the plugin's declared functionality, but the interface directly feeds unvalidated external inputs (candidate paths, search roots) into filesystem read APIs, which is a genuinely reachable abuse path; read content is not returned to the caller and is blind comparison, so it is rated MEDIUM rather than higher.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh 声明有效，补丁为普通插入，未发现仿冒或保留名迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration is valid, the patch is a plain insertion, and no impersonation or reserved-name signs were found.

summary.zh: 静态规则扫描完成：预扫 5 处子进程执行导入逐条审读均为良性（系统索引命令与开发脚本），未发现其他危险调用。
summary.en: Static rule scanning completed: the 5 subprocess-execution imports found in the pre-scan were each reviewed and all are benign (system index commands and development scripts); no other dangerous calls were found.

summary.zh: 行为面检查通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外部网络外联。
summary.en: Behavior surface checks passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, and no external network outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：无工具描述与系统提示注入面，文档无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tool-description or system-prompt injection surface; no injection wording in documentation.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用）。机械预扫命中 5 处子进程执行导入（DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55），逐条审读后全部判定为良性：lib/index.js:5 与 lib/types/platform-search.js:1 与 src/platform-search.ts:1 是文件定位功能调用系统索引命令（execFile 数组参数、无 shell 拼接、输入已转义），scripts/build.mjs:2 与 scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6 是开发期构建与文案校验脚本，均不构成任意代码执行，未产出 finding（排除理由见 DG-D3 检测痕迹）。插件未声明能力清单，network/shell/fs/modelFacing 按代码实测推断。包元数据指向 omdsh-dev 组织仓库，本次审计对象为 bill9109 的 fork，属同一项目重发布，未发现版本或内容篡改迹象。插件自身不启动独立 Web 服务，本地无认证暴露面属宿主固有风险；能力兼容性未经真实宿主验证（untested）。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (L4 not enabled). Mechanical pre-scans hit 5 subprocess-execution imports (DSH-X03 → DG-R3-55), and after individual review all were classified as benign: lib/index.js:5, lib/types/platform-search.js:1, and src/platform-search.ts:1 are the file-location feature calling system index commands (execFile with array arguments, no shell concatenation, inputs escaped); scripts/build.mjs:2 and scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6 are development build and copy-verification scripts, none constitute arbitrary code execution; no finding was produced (exclusion rationale per DG-D3 detection traces). The plugin does not declare a capability list; network/shell/fs/modelFacing are inferred from code measurements. Package metadata points to the omdsh-dev organization repository; the audited object is bill9109's fork, a same-project re-release, with no signs of version or content tampering. The plugin itself does not start an independent web service; the local unauthenticated exposure is an inherent host risk; capability compatibility was not verified against a real host (untested).
